svg.aria-label: Map of Tonga with centered national overview and enlarged island-group details
svg.metadata: Tonga national overview retains the existing GSHHS/GSHHG intermediate-resolution coastline composition (WGS84), with Eua, Haapai and Niuas supplemental geometry from the Apache Superset Tonga country-map GeoJSON. The enlarged Tongatapu, Vava'u, Ha'apai and ʻEua detail insets use high-detail OpenStreetMap-derived ISO 3166-2 boundary geometry from hyperknot/country-levels-export (© OpenStreetMap contributors; ODbL 1.0), projected with the existing JOURNEY ATLAS multi-region local equirectangular fit. Real Scene coordinates, inset bounds and the centered national overview are unchanged. Reviewed 2026-10-05.
